```{r global, include=FALSE}
library(tidymodels)
library(shiny)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(vip)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(themis)
library(xgboost)
library(DT)

# Load and clean data
dataRaw <- read_csv("healthcare.csv")

set.seed(123)
dataClean <- dataRaw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    ever_married = if_else(ever_married == "Yes", 1L, 0L),
    residence_type = if_else(residence_type == "Urban", 1L, 0L),
    gender = if_else(gender == "Male", 1L, 0L),
    stroke = factor(stroke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    work_type = as.factor(work_type),
    smoking_status = as.factor(smoking_status),
    bmi = as.numeric(na_if(bmi, "N/A"))
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(smoking_status != "Unknown")

splits <- initial_split(dataClean, strata = stroke)
dataTrain <- training(splits)
dataTest <- testing(splits)
val_set <- validation_split(dataTrain, strata = stroke, prop = 0.8)

xgb_recipe <- recipe(stroke ~ ., data = dataTrain) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal(), -all_outcomes()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_smote(stroke)

xgb_mod <- boost_tree(trees = 1000, tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(),
                      loss_reduction = tune(), sample_size = tune(), mtry = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

xgb_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(xgb_mod) %>%
  add_recipe(xgb_recipe)

xgb_res <- tune_grid(
  xgb_workflow,
  resamples = val_set,
  grid = 10,
  metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy, sens, specificity),
  control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
)

xgb_best <- select_best(xgb_res, metric = "roc_auc")
xgb_workflow_best <- finalize_workflow(xgb_workflow, xgb_best)
xgb_last_fit <- last_fit(xgb_workflow_best, splits)
xgb_preds <- collect_predictions(xgb_last_fit)
xgb_metrics <- metric_set(sens, specificity, ppv, npv, accuracy, roc_auc)(xgb_preds, truth = stroke, estimate = .pred_class, .pred_Yes)
```

Model Summary and Evaluation
===

## Data Viewer
```{r}
dataClean %>% 
  select(age, gender, hypertension, heart_disease, ever_married, work_type, Residence_type = residence_type, avg_glucose_level, bmi, smoking_status, stroke) %>% 
  datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
```

## Variable Importance
```{r}
xgb_last_fit$.workflow[[1]] %>%
  pull_workflow_fit() %>%
  vip(num_features = 10)
```

## Confusion Matrix
```{r}
xgb_last_fit %>%
  collect_predictions() %>%
  conf_mat(truth = stroke, estimate = .pred_class) %>%
  autoplot(type = "heatmap")
```

## ROC Curve
```{r}
xgb_last_fit %>%
  collect_predictions() %>%
  roc_curve(truth = stroke, .pred_Yes) %>%
  autoplot()
```

## Prediction Metrics
```{r}
xgb_metrics %>%
  select(.metric, .estimate)
```
